However, no test in `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` explicitly exercises this new code path. The existing test `test_per_command_config_commit_keeps_the_merged_pr_check` uses valid directories (`/other/dir`) that would not trigger the "could not resolve git command directory" warning, so the new confirmation behavior for unresolved directories is untested.
